text.en:
Attachment. The NIA is hereby aitached to the OP for policy and
program coordination.

Separability. If any provision of this Order is declared invalid or
unconstitutional, other portions not affected thereby shall remain valid and subsisting.

Repeal. EO No. 168 (s. 2022) is hereby repealed. All other
issuances, orders, rules and regulations, or parts thereof that are inconsistent with this
Order are hereby repealed or modified accordingly.

Effectivity. This Order shall take effect immediately.
DONE, in the City of Manila, this 5th
year of our Lord, Two Thousand and Twenty-Four.
day of September , in the
By the President:
LUCAS P. BERSAMIN
